payload.posture: Read Psalms 110:1 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a short enthronement saying places David’s Lord at the LORD’s right hand until enemies become a footstool. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
